Hello,

 

Hope you can help me with this.  How do I get a R web app (consisting of ui.R and server.R files) that uses “system2” command to invoke a C executable to run on “shinyapps.io”?   This combination had successfully ran  on a virtual machine that has shiny server installed.

Thanks for any help.
